tables.name: Culture
tables.description: The aspect of daily life the capital's people place value in. Non-Specific skips Pursuit of Culture.

results.name: Non-Specific
results.description: Culture within the capital is shaped simply by their environment and current events.

results.name: Art & Beauty
results.description: Citizens believe life finds its meaning in the appreciation of the world and its beauty, exploring it through creative pursuits.

results.name: Music
results.description: Citizens believe life finds its meaning in the making and experiencing of music, the true language of the soul.

results.name: Cuisine
results.description: Citizens believe life finds its meaning in the creation and consumption of excellent food, and the joy it can bring to all.

results.name: Self-Improvement
results.description: Citizens believe life finds its meaning through the endless pursuit of bettering oneself, inside and out.

results.name: Enjoyment
results.description: Citizens believe life finds its meaning in the pursuit of happiness and fun.

results.name: Challenge
results.description: Citizens believe life finds its meaning in struggle and overcoming obstacles.
